_meta.source: Written for this app. Stage structure follows the shape of the Singapore education and training system; choices are written so none is the correct answer.
_meta.notes: No choice is scored right or wrong and no combination produces a failure. Every stage advances. The ledger records what a player gathered, not how well they did. Doors never go to zero.

stages.title: Sec 3
stages.situation: New subjects, new classes, and some friends are now in different rooms.

choices.label: Go hard at what you are good at
choices.outcome: You get better at what you were already decent at. A narrower year than it could have been.

choices.label: Work at the subject you find hardest
choices.outcome: A slog. You are still not top of the class, and no longer afraid of it.

choices.label: Take something outside class seriously
choices.outcome: It costs you study time. You end the year with three adults who would vouch for you.

stages.title: Sec 4
stages.situation: The exam year. Everyone has an opinion, and most have seen one route.

choices.label: Focus entirely on the results
choices.outcome: A clean, narrow year. You go in as ready as you were going to be.

choices.label: Study, and go and look around
choices.outcome: You lose some weekends to open houses, and find a course you cannot stop thinking about.

choices.label: Apply through Early Admissions
choices.outcome: You have to say what you want to a stranger. That turns out to be the hard part.

stages.title: Results
stages.situation: The envelope. This is the moment that feels like a verdict and is not one.

choices.label: Take the route your results point at
choices.outcome: Straightforward, and there is nothing wrong with that. You start in September.

choices.label: Take a longer road to what you want
choices.outcome: A year or two more than your friends. You chose the destination, not the shortest road.

choices.label: Take a fifth year
choices.outcome: One more year in the same uniform. In ten years nobody can tell.

stages.title: First year after school
stages.situation: Nobody checks if you did the reading. The people are from everywhere.

choices.label: Head down, do the work
choices.outcome: Solid marks, few surprises. You are on track.

choices.label: Get involved beyond the course
choices.outcome: Marks dip a little. You know people two years ahead who tell you things.

choices.label: Start something of your own
choices.outcome: Most weekends go. You have something that is entirely yours.

stages.title: Finishing
stages.situation: The end is in sight. What do you do with what you are about to hold?

choices.label: Straight into work
choices.outcome: Earning while others study. The learning carries on, on someone's payroll.

choices.label: Keep studying, further up
choices.outcome: More years, and a wider set of roles at the end of them.

choices.label: Work study, and do both
choices.outcome: Employed and studying at once. Genuinely hard, and you finish with both.

stages.title: Early working years
stages.situation: The work is not what the course described, and a lot of it is other people.

choices.label: Get very good at your one thing
choices.outcome: You become the person they come to for it. Deep and narrow.

choices.label: Learn how the whole place works
choices.outcome: Best at nothing, and you can see how the pieces fit, which is rarer.

choices.label: Keep building the side thing
choices.outcome: Two lives at once, tiring and interesting. People start to know the side thing.

stages.title: The first real crossroads
stages.situation: You could stay on this road a decade and be fine. Something asks whether fine is the plan.

choices.label: Stay, and go deeper
choices.outcome: Mastery is real and it takes years. You choose to spend them.

choices.label: Move sideways into something near
choices.outcome: Most of what you know still applies. A beginner again in the rest, briefly.

choices.label: Upgrade part time while working
choices.outcome: Two years of evenings, and a qualification you did not have at nineteen.

stages.title: Building something
stages.situation: People ask your opinion now. That is a kind of power and easy to spend badly.

choices.label: Take charge of other people's work
choices.outcome: Managing is a different job from doing, and you learn it from scratch.

choices.label: Stay hands on, become expert
choices.outcome: You keep doing the work instead of talking about it. Fewer meetings, more craft.

choices.label: Start your own thing
choices.outcome: Everything depends on you now, which is the frightening part and the point.

stages.title: The ground moves
stages.situation: Your field is not what it was. Some of your work is done differently now.

choices.label: Learn the new tools early
choices.outcome: Ahead of the curve instead of under it. The change becomes an advantage.

choices.label: Move to the part it did not touch
choices.outcome: A sensible sidestep. The work is still there and it is quieter.

choices.label: Retrain, into something else
choices.outcome: You use what exists for this and start again on purpose. Not a fall, a decision.

stages.title: Looking both ways
stages.situation: Perhaps halfway through your working life. There is a lot of it left.

choices.label: Do the thing you always meant to
choices.outcome: A $4,000 credit and an allowance while you study. Oldest in the room, and it does not matter.

choices.label: Teach what you know to people coming up
choices.outcome: You tell them the real version, including what went badly. More use than the tidy one.

choices.label: Keep going, keep learning in the work
choices.outcome: No dramatic move. Steady, and still curious, which is rare at forty two.

endingFrames.title: You kept the map wide.
endingFrames.body: More is open to you than when you started. That is what happens when someone keeps looking.

endingFrames.title: You got genuinely good at something.
endingFrames.body: Depth is its own freedom. People who are properly skilled are rarely short of options.

endingFrames.title: People know who you are.
endingFrames.body: Most of what happens at work comes through someone who thought of you.

endingFrames.title: You made things.
endingFrames.body: A record of what you can do that depends on nobody's grading. It opened doors no score could.
